## [0.6.6] - 2026-09-03

### Added

- Wallet passes now track the moment they're actually confirmed installed on a wallet app (PassCreator's `first_pushnotification_registered` webhook, given its own dedicated subscription URL alongside the existing void/registration ones), not just when a pass is issued. Reports' Wallets tab "Time to wallet install" card (renamed from "Time to wallet tap") now measures from the ticket email to that confirmed install instead of to the earlier "Add to Wallet" tap, which only reflected how fast someone opened the email rather than whether the pass ever actually installed. A one-time ops script backfills this for passes issued before the change, from PassCreator's own record of the pass's first device download.
- Reports' Wallets tab has a new "Devices per attendee" card: some attendees add their ticket to more than one device (a phone and a smartwatch, say), so the number of active wallet installations can run higher than the number of people who installed one at all. The new card groups confirmed attendees by how many devices/wallet accounts they're actually using (1, 2, 3, or 4+), and the Wallet platform card next to it is now explicitly worded as attendee counts to keep the distinction clear. The Wallet PDF export gets a matching "Devices per attendee" table.
- Reports' Wallets tab has a new "Wallet lifecycle" card: every other card on the tab answers "how many have a wallet pass installed right now", but none of them show who installed a pass and later removed it. The new card splits every issued pass into active (installed on at least one device now), removed (installed at some point, since removed from every device), or never installed, which can surface a UX or communication problem the adoption numbers alone hide (e.g. many installs followed by many removals before the event). It pairs with "Admission rate by wallet status" for a full 4x2 grid instead of that card sitting alone in its own row. The Wallet PDF export gets a matching "Wallet lifecycle" table.
- Ticket pages now show an Add to Samsung Wallet button alongside the existing Apple/Google Wallet ones when Samsung Wallet is enabled for the event. It isn't tappable yet since PassCreator hasn't finished activating Samsung Wallet support, but it reads the event's real Wallet settings rather than being hardcoded. The Attendees table, an attendee's own Wallet card, and its wallet-links menu all read real per-attendee Samsung registration status the same way they already do for Apple/Google, replacing the previous fixed "not supported" placeholder text.
- Reports' Wallets tab, and the wallet CSV/PDF export, now read real per-attendee Samsung Wallet registration data too, matching the rest of the product - the platform donut's Samsung slice, "Wallet lifecycle", "Devices per attendee", and the admission-rate comparison all count a Samsung-only confirmed pass the same way they already count Apple/Google-only ones, instead of the platform donut's previous hardcoded 0. The CSV export gets matching Samsung active/inactive registration columns, and the PDF's platform table gets a "Samsung Wallet only" row.
- Reports has a new "Mail" tab: delivery-attempt status breakdown, attendee reach deduped across resends (an attendee whose first send bounced but whose resend then succeeded counts as reached exactly once, not per attempt), an initial-vs-resend split, per-template success rate, a cumulative chart of successful sends over time, and how many reached attendees went on to open their ticket page online at least once. That last card deliberately doesn't rely on email-open or click tracking, which Admitto doesn't have - only on real delivery outcomes and the public ticket page's own page views, the two signals actually populated today.
- Reports' Mail tab has two more cards: "Admission rate by email status" compares check-in rate between attendees email reached and attendees it didn't, the same comparison the Wallets tab already shows for wallet status. "Event journey" shows how many attendees reached each stage of the event - got a ticket email, installed a wallet pass, attended - as an independent count per stage rather than a strictly narrowing funnel, since an attendee can reach a later stage (installing a wallet pass, say) without having reached an earlier one through email.
- Reports' Wallets tab has a new "Time to install after reminder" card, and the wallet CSV/PDF export gets a matching "Most recent reminder email sent at" column. "Time to wallet install" always measures from the very first ticket email and stays exactly as it was - a slow-adopter signal worth acting on regardless of whether a reminder was ever sent - but once a reminder campaign is actually running, crediting a fast reminder-driven install to the original, ignored ticket email makes the reminder look like it didn't help. The new card measures from the most recent email that carried a wallet "Add to Wallet" button instead, for whoever actually got one before installing - any Communication campaign, not just one specifically named or tagged as a reminder, since the wallet-link placeholders are available in every template and any of them could include the button. A reminder delivered after someone already installed is excluded rather than becoming a nonsensical anchor.
- Communication's template editor no longer offers (or accepts saving) an Add to Apple/Google Wallet placeholder for a platform the event doesn't currently have turned on in Wallet settings - the button couldn't have produced a working link, so a template built or copied before the platform was disabled now has to drop it (or the platform turned back on) before it can be saved again, the same "Unknown placeholder" error a genuinely unrecognized token already gets.

### Security

- Event Settings → Wallet's Template ID field now locks once any wallet pass has been issued for the event - the wallet provider scopes a pass lookup to the template it was created under, permanently, so changing the Template ID afterwards silently made every issued pass unmanageable (sync, void/restore, push) without any warning. The API key remains editable at any time (rotating a leaked key must still work), but saving a new one for an event with issued passes now live-verifies it against the currently configured template first and rejects it if it can't reach that template, so a key for the wrong PassCreator account can't silently take over an event's real wallet passes. Clearing the API key entirely (rather than replacing it) now also asks for confirmation once passes have been issued, since it silently stops all syncing, voiding, restoring, and pushing for them until a working key is set again.
- Event Settings → Wallet now asks for confirmation before turning off wallet passes for an event that already has issued passes, or before turning off a single platform (Apple/Google/Samsung) that already has attendees who added it. Turning off wallet passes entirely silently stopped syncing, voiding, restoring, and pushing updates for every issued pass, and dropped any PassCreator webhook notification (a device registration, a removal) that arrived while it was off, with no warning it had happened - the periodic background sync still catches these up once wallet passes are turned back on, so nothing is lost permanently, just delayed. Turning off a single platform doesn't touch syncing, but hides that platform's Add to Wallet button for new attendees and made its already-installed passes disappear from the Attendees list and attendee detail pages until it was turned back on - the confirmation also says when the same save will push an update to every installed pass, since disabling Apple Wallet on an event with a start time can trigger that on its own.

### Fixed

- Reports' Wallet adoption gauge showed a "Voided" ring alongside Issued and Installed, but a voided pass is pulled from the wallet app the moment it's deactivated - so it never reflects actual adoption and only added noise. It's been removed, along with the ring-order bug that rendered it as the outermost (most prominent) ring instead of innermost. The Issued row's percentage now also shows what it's a share of ("of attendees"), matching the Installed row's existing "of issued" label, and the card's description no longer wrongly claims a pass is issued when the ticket email goes out - it's issued when the attendee first taps Add to Wallet. Reports' Wallet platform donut dropped its "No wallet installed" slice for the same reason - it isn't a platform - and now shows each platform's share of installed passes instead of issued ones. The Wallet PDF export mirrors both changes.
- Reports' Wallets tab logged a Recharts "width(0) and height(0)" console warning when navigating away from it, the same issue already fixed on the Custom fields tab - its charts were never gated on tab visibility. Every wallet chart now unmounts while its tab is hidden and remounts instantly when it's shown again, without needing to refetch data.

---

### Deploy
- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:0.6.6` (rolling `:0.6`)
- Migrations apply **automatically on container start**. **No manual `migrate deploy`.** Back up the database yourself before upgrading (the stack no longer takes an automatic pre-migration backup).
